# `encodeURIComponent()`

[External Documentation](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/encodeURIComponent) 

Encodes a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) component by replacing certain characters with UTF-8 escape sequences.

*   Returns: Encoded string
